mapper.select: SELECT o.ID as orderId, o.ORDER_DATE as orderDate, os.ORDER_STATUS as orderStatus, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT as totalAmount, od.UNIT_PRICE as unitPrice, od.DISCOUNT_PRICE as discountPrice, od.QUANTITY as quantity, os.DESCRIPTION as orderStatus, d.DELIVERY_STATUS as deliveryStatus, d.CARRIER as carrier, d.TRACKING_NUMBER as trackingNumber, d.ESTIMATED_ARRIVAL_DATE as estimatedArrivalDate FROM ORDER_TB o JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TB od ON o.ID = od.ORDER_ID JOIN ORDER_STATUS_TB os ON o.ID = os.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TB d ON o.ID = d.ORDER_ID WHERE o.IDENTIFIER_ID = #{customerId} AND o.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC
